questions.question: If 21 May 2009 is Thursday, then what will be the day of the week on 15 July 2017?
questions.solution:
An ordinary year has 1 odd day and a leap year has 2 odd days. 

So, the day on the same date for an ordinary year will be 1 day ahead and the day on the same date for a leap year will be 2 days ahead for the next year.

If 21 May 2009 is Thursday, then the day on these dates will be:

21 May 2010 → Friday

21 May 2011 → Saturday

21 May 2012 → Monday

21 May 2013 → Tuesday

21 May 2014 → Wednesday

21 May 2015 → Thursday

21 May 2016 → Saturday

21 May 2017 → Sunday

Number of days between 21 May 2017 to 15 July 2017 = (10 + 30 + 15) = 55

55 when divided by 7, leaves 6 as remainder.

Sunday + 6 = Saturday

Therefore, it will be Saturday on 15 July 2017.

Hence, ‘**Saturday**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(**NOTE:** Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13-Operations on 13 such as adding/ subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

46 - 12 - 17 and 62 - 12 - 25
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **(Third number × 2) + Second number = First number

 
• 46 - 12 - 17 → 17 × 2 + 12 = 34 + 12 = 46
 
• 62 - 12 - 25 → 25 × 2 + 12 = 50 + 12 = 62

Similarly,

 
• 85 - 13 - 36 → 36 × 2 + 13 = 72 + 13 = 85

Hence, '**85 - 13 - 36**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

AB_N _DOP E_QR _HST IJU_
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• MCGIV → AB**M**N / **C**DOP / E**G**QR / **I**HST / IJU**V**
 
• CMGIV → AB**C**N / **M**DOP / EGQR / IHST / IJUV
 
• CMGFV → ABCN / MDOP / EGQR / **F**HST / IJU**V**
 
• MCFGV → ABMN / CDOP / E**F**QR / **G**HST / IJU**V**

When the sequence is divided into five equal parts, in option 4, we see that the first two letters and last two letters forms the alphabet series ABCDEFGHIJ - MNOPQRSTUV.

Hence, '**MCFGV**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: Three of the following four letter - clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that does NOT belong to that group?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa718dc3d80fa09b3eda3b7ebcb501ae0d35fbb68f85c6fcb0b5de22c71bf85f.png] 

**Logic: **First letter + 2 = Second letter; Second letter + 2 = Third letter

 
• PRT → P + 2 = R; R + 2 = T
 
• **ACD → A + 2 = C; C + 2 = E ≠ D**
 
• UWY → U + 2 = W; W + 2 = Y
 
• BDF → B + 2 = D; D + 2 = F

Hence, '**ACD**' is the correct answer.
